create_tap_action_wrapper: create a TapActionWrapper instance wrapping an AndroidEnv with configurable tap duration and touch_only mode
build_tap_action_sequence: build a sequence of touch and lift actions from a single tap action using _process_action
run_tap_action_step: run a step in the wrapped environment that executes multiple touch frames followed by a lift action
review_action_spec: review the action_spec method to see how touch_only mode restricts action types to discrete touch only
summarize_tap_wrapper_stats: summarize the environment stats including env_steps tracked by the TapActionWrapper
